target.role: Director, Total Fund Management Investment Analytics

summary: Investment analytics professional with ~7 years across multi-asset portfolio analytics, ALM, and AI-enabled platform delivery for pension and institutional investors. At Moody's Analytics holds delegated sign-off on valuation, risk, and ALM outputs for portfolios of $5–25bn per engagement, and led design of a cross-asset cash flow, liquidity, and scenario engine. Ex-Ortec Finance ALM consultant to Canadian pensions (VaR/CVaR optimization, portfolio construction, LDI). Familiar with Total Fund analytics needs across leverage, liquidity, and cross-asset exposures. CFA + dual MSc.
core_skills: ALM, liquidity gap & cash flow projection modelling
Risk analytics: VaR/CVaR, risk decomposition & attribution
Portfolio construction analytics: asset-only & asset-liability optimization
AI-assisted development & agentic workflows (Claude Code, Cursor)
Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy), SQL & production analytics pipelines
Stakeholder partnership with investment committees, Heads of Risk & CIO offices

roles.title: Assistant Director – Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Analytics Lead)

sections.heading: Investment Analytics & Portfolio Insight
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional client portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative book), spanning pensions, asset managers, and insurers.

Review and validate aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics — covering duration, cross-asset exposures, and scenario impacts — feeding downstream ALM, Total Fund reporting, and investment-committee narratives.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; ensure consistency of sensitivities and stress impacts at portfolio-level ALM aggregates for client investment committees.

sections.heading: Analytics Platform Development & Scenario Engineering
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — delivering forward-looking liquidity and funding visibility across ALM horizons.

Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year), enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions; embedded behavioral cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) — automated code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection — reducing development cycle time an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Model Governance & Stakeholder Partnership
bullets: Operate within Moody's formal model governance framework — independently review curve construction, spread calibration, cross-asset interactions, and stress behaviour prior to production release; establish documentation and validation standards consistent with industry model-risk-management expectations.

Serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues; interface directly with Heads of Risk and CIO-office stakeholders, translating quantitative outputs into investment-committee-ready narratives.

Translate client investment-team requirements into structured Product Owner development requests; coordinate across product, engineering, and QA functions in cross-functional squad delivery and validate outputs post-deployment.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe multi-asset analytics platform; translated investment-team requirements into Product Owner development requests.
Successfully migrated all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM, validating asset, liability, and ALM configurations post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant – IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — aligned regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program management on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness materials.

Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors — analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk under stochastic economic scenarios.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio construction and optimization based on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform; conducted risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis — trade-offs between return objectives, duration alignment, leverage overlays, and liquidity for pension-fund clients; advised on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation via stress testing and sensitivity analysis across cross-asset exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk; performed cross-asset hedging analysis for international institutional clients.

Led the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger (new jointly-sponsored plan, analogous to a Total Fund build) — on a team of three, developed and validated the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics and evaluated duration, inflation, currency, and leverage overlay strategies.
Presented ALM study findings to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) – Western University, 2016
